_comment: MachLib claim registry. Each entry ties a PROSE CLAIM (claim_text substrings that must appear, whitespace-normalized, in source_file) to the theorem it cites and the axioms that claim forbids. `claim_audit.py` resolves each against `#print axioms`. Adding a headline that calls a theorem 'clean' WITHOUT registering it here is the intended anti-pattern the auditor exists to discourage.

This is the invariant that distinguishes it from the mixed bound below.
claim_text: no analyticity, no logarithm, no reciprocal

claims._comment: The full mixed exp/log/reciprocal EML barrier bound. It LEGITIMATELY uses the analytic identity theorem + log/reciprocal (for the degenerate proportional leaves), so those are NOT forbidden here — the invariant is only that it stays free of hidden `sorry` and of the classical zero-count escape hatch. Contrast the pure-exp entry above: the pair pins the honest distinction.

The concrete showcase: e^(e^x) − x·e^x has ≤ 47 real zeros, a machine-checked instance of the pure-exp explicit bound. Stays in the ROLLE-ONLY class (it is a pure-exp barrier), and — because the bound value is a KERNEL-checked `decide` on Ndep 0 1 = 47 — must NOT regress to `native_decide` (which would add `ofReduceBool` and move the '47' out of the kernel-checked footprint).

The mixed-capstone showcase: e^x − log x has finitely many zeros. A genuine exp+log function, so — unlike the pure-exp '47' entry — it LEGITIMATELY uses the analytic identity theorem + log; those are NOT forbidden. The invariant is only that this concrete instance stays free of hidden `sorry` and the classical zero-count escape hatch, i.e. it inherits exactly the mixed capstone's honest footprint.

Invariant: sorryAx-free (a real emitC_correct + absenc_sub_rounded composition).

claim_text: ZERO new axioms anywhere in the arc that built this

claims._comment: Kalman/Gaussian MMSE-optimality arc: the Bayesian conjugacy factorization (joint = marginal x posterior via completing the square), proven from scratch in MachLib's Mathlib-free base, zero new axioms. Invariant: sorryAx-free.
The scalar Kalman/posterior mean minimizes the conditional MSE (tau2 <= tau2+(c-m)^2), achieving the posterior variance. Parallel-axis at the posterior. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The posterior-mean (Kalman) estimator's total unconditional MSE is exactly tau2 (the posterior variance); mse_lower_bound shows nothing continuous beats it. Iterated-integral device, no 2-D integration. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The COMPOSITION: the Q16.16 Kalman kernel is near-MMSE-optimal. Its conditional MSE lies in [tau2, tau2+eps^2] -- the excess risk of the IMPLEMENTED estimator over the provably-optimal posterior mean is <= eps^2 (eps the datapath forward error). The machine-checked join of posterior_mean_mmse + kalman_update_1d_fwd_error, not a prose assertion. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The RECURSIVE fixed-point error of the Kalman variance recursion -- what a filter needs beyond a single measurement update. The autonomous variance map g(P)=P*r/(P+r) is a scalar contraction (r^2/(b+r)^2-Lipschitz on {P>=b}), so the Q16.16 recursion stays within eps*geom(L,n) of the exact recursion over n steps: eps*n at b=0 (nonexpansive), and uniformly bounded for all n at b>0 (strict contraction). Instantiates the pre-existing contraction backbone; the estimate (m) recursion is the coupled follow-on. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The nonexpansive (b=0) corollary: the variance recursion accumulates error additively at eps*n -- the honest ~N*ulp linear growth, unconditional (needs only both variances >= 0). Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The COUPLED half: the estimate (m) recursion fixed-point error. The estimate update is a time-varying affine map whose computed and exact orbits follow DIFFERENT maps (computed gain Kc vs exact Ke). Proven via nearby_maps_trajectory_bound (two orbits under nearby L-Lipschitz maps stay close), instantiated at Ac n x = x + Kc n*(z n - x). The gain-error x innovation bound rho carries the coupling to the variance error; sigma the update round-off. |mc n - me n| <= (sigma+rho)*geom L n. Invariant: sorryAx-free.
claim_text: coupled half of the recursive fixed-point error

claims._comment: The general backbone lemma the estimate recursion needs: two orbits under NEARBY L-Lipschitz maps (computed map Ac n L-Lipschitz + agreeing with exact map Ae n on the exact orbit to rho + computed orbit following Ac up to round-off sigma) stay within (sigma+rho)*geom L n. Generalizes local_lipschitz_trajectory_bound from same-map to different-map -- the perturbation bound for a linear time-varying recursion with perturbed coefficients. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The coupling made NUMERIC: the fully-coupled estimate recursion bound where rho is no longer a hypothesis but derived from the variance error. Composes kalman_gain_error_bound (variance error -> gain error via the gain map's r/(b+r)^2-Lipschitz constant, K=g/r) with kalman_estimate_recursion_fixed_point. |mc n - me n| <= (sigma + (gamma + (r/(b+r)^2)*DP)*Z)*geom L n. The variance -> gain -> estimate coupling machine-checked end to end. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The gain map K(P)=P/(P+r) is r/(b+r)^2-Lipschitz on {P>=b} -- the variance map's r^2/(b+r)^2 divided by r (g = r*K). This is the gain's sensitivity to the variance, the link that carries a variance error into the gain error. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The AXI4-Stream wrapper control FSM (idle/busy/present Moore machine around the multi-cycle Kalman core) cannot deadlock, drop a sample, or re-trigger the core mid-run. conservation: accepted = emitted + occ(state), occ in {0,1}, input accepted only from idle -> no dropped sample. round_trip: bounded single-beat cycle. validIn_pulse: 1-cycle pulse, timing contract respected. Pure discrete Bool/Nat reasoning, no MachLib.Real, sorryAx-free. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

Bounded, single-beat round trip of the AXI-Stream wrapper: from idle, once the three handshake signals arrive, it accepts one input, runs the core, emits exactly one output, and returns to idle -- accepted/emitted each +1. The deadlock-freedom / no-lock-up guarantee. sorryAx-free (in fact zero MachLib axioms). Invariant: sorryAx-free.

Fixed-point forward error of the 2x2 symmetric matrix inverse (the dimension the EKF/kalman2d gain actually uses). A^-1 = (1/det)[[d,-b],[-b,a]] = one reciprocal + qmuls, so each entry qmul(cofactor,recip) is within s + |cofactor|*Erec of cofactor/det. Fixed-size, no dynamic loops, no Cholesky/LDLT. sorryAx-free. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The divergence bound: the 2x2 inverse's reciprocal approximates 1/det_fx (computed determinant); as an approximation of the exact 1/det its error is <= Erec0 + Edet*|wf|*|w| with |wf|*|w| = 1/(|det_fx|*|det|), bounded iff the matrix is well-conditioned (det away from 0) -- the precise sense in which fixed-point rounding doesn't make the filter diverge. sorryAx-free. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The gain/update composition: the Kalman gain K=P*H^T*S^-1 is a matrix product, so a gain entry is a dot product of a P*H^T row with an S^-1 column. kalman2_gain_entry_via_inverse folds fxerr_dot2 (two fxerr_mul + fxerr_add) with the two inverse-column entries (built from the shared reciprocal, carrying inversion error Erec) plugged in -> the gain entry's fixed-point error is bounded, Erec appearing explicitly. sorryAx-free. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The 2x2 Kalman state update forward error: x'_i = x_i + (K_i0*y0 + K_i1*y1), prior plus gain-row-dot-innovation. Folds fxerr_dot2 (K*y) and fxerr_add (+x) over the gain entries' FxErr (carrying inversion error) -> the estimate path inverse->gain->x' is forward-error-bounded end to end for the 2-measurement 2x2 update. sorryAx-free. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

2-D Kalman MMSE-optimality (trace loss): the posterior-mean vector minimizes E[|X-c|^2]. The trace loss separates per component, so the vector optimality is the sum of two scalar posterior_mean_mmse -- no 2-D integration. matrix2_posterior_mean_mmse: tr(Sigma_post) <= any estimate's total conditional MSE. matrix2_mmse_excess: excess risk is exactly |c-m|^2, so the mean vector is the unique minimizer. sorryAx-free. Invariant: sorryAx-free.

The Joseph-form 2x2 covariance update P+ = (I-K)P(I-K)^T + KRK^T stays symmetric PSD for ANY gain K -- the numerical-robustness guarantee for a recursive covariance filter. Scoped to 2x2, quadratic-form PSD predicate (Psd2), congruence + sum preservation. sorryAx-free, zero new axioms. Invariant: sorryAx-free.
claim_text: stays symmetric positive-semidefinite for any gain K
